definitions.gloss: to clear up completely; to be clear across the whole sky
definitions.explanation: Of the sky or weather: to be clear and cloudless from one horizon to the other. Mostly used in the past or ている forms to describe a bright, clear day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{晴|は}れ{渡|わた}った。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雲|くも}→雲：02202_kumo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧{晴|は}れ{渡|わた}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Today the sky is clear without a single cloud.

examples.japanese: {晴|は}れ{渡|わた}った⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The sports day was held under a clear autumn sky.

notes:
⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧ adds the sense of spreading over a whole area. The adnominal {晴|は}れ{渡|わた}った⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧ (a clear, cloudless sky) is the commonest use.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {晴|は}れ{渡|わた}った⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧: a clear blue sky
- ⟦{雲|くも}→雲：02202_kumo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧{晴|は}れ{渡|わた}る: to be clear without a single cloud
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{晴|は}れ{渡|わた}る: (figurative) to feel completely refreshed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{晴|は}れる→晴れる：00701_hareru⟧: to clear up — the plain word
- ⟦{快晴|かいせい}→快晴：00137_kaisei⟧: perfectly fine weather (a noun)
